note: Natural wikitext lines, no cue template anywhere. The gate is read at every position of a real sentence; the scored point is the position whose next token starts a tape-backed entity. Off-tape entities are the control that separates 'I hold this' from 'something surprising is coming' — they are equally rare and equally entity-shaped, and the tape simply does not have them. OPEN_GATE_POSITIONAL is the honest verdict when the gate finds fact positions but fires on off-tape entities too. Fit and eval lines are disjoint; trunk and P1 frozen; only W_q, gate and tau train.
